out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO HAND SOAP AT BAR HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CFM PROVIDED HAND SOAP FOR BAR HAND SINK.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED MAXIMUM HOT WATER AT BAR HAND SINK AT 75F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. CFM WILL PLACE WORK ORDER TO REPAIR HOT WATER AT BAR HAND SINK. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF LIQUID AND JUICE RESIDUES AT BAR AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CLEAN ALL SURFACES OF BAR AREA TO REMOVE STICKY RESIDUES.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED SINK BASIN AT BACK HAND SINK (NEXT TO BACK EXIT DOOR) SLOW TO DRAIN.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. CFM STATED THEY ARE AWARE OF PLUMBING ISSUE AND ARE WORKING TO REPAIR. GLORY DAYS GRILL (Inspection Date: 05/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED FAUCET AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK LEAKING.
violations.corrective_action: CFM IS AWARE OF ISSUE AND WORKING ON REPAIR.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Materials Smooth, Durable, Cleanable
violations.observation: OBSERVED CRACKED, CHIPPED, MISSING TILES AT BAR FLOORING, AT MAIN KITCHEN DISH WASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: FLOOR surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, warewashing areas, and toilet rooms. REPAIR CRACKED, CHIPPED AND MISSING TILES AT BAR AND MAIN KITCHEN AREAS.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED OPENINGS TO EXTERIOR AT BACK EXIT DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM AWARE OF ISSUE. INSTALL WEATHER STRIPPING OR DOOR SWEEP TO BACK EXIT DOOR TO CLOSE ANY OPENINGS TO EXTERIOR.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed chemical dish machine at 0ppm chlorine solution after priming and running cycle 5 times.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CFM contacted dish machine company for immediate service. Service is scheduled for following day. EHS and CFM discussed using dish machine for washing and rinsing only and using sanitizer basin of 3 compartment sink to sanitize all dishes until repair is complete. EHS will follow up within 3 days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed handsink near back exit door being used to rinse wiping cloth.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS advised CFM to review designated use of sinks with food service employees.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed paper towel roll improperly installed so that dispenser not working.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM reconfigured paper towels in dispenser so that paper towels were able to be dispensed.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The following farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3). CFM could not produce parasite destruction letter from supplier.
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. CFM will request parasite destruction letter from supplier. EHS will follow up on or around 10 days.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed container of raw ribeye steaks stored on shelf above portioned RTE sides in #7.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved steaks to bottom shelf. GLORY DAYS GRILL (Inspection Date: 07/28/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cooked chicken wings in #2 at 52F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded chicken wings. EHS observed unit at 55F. EHS advised CFM to request service for unit and not to store TCS foods until repaired.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: #5, #6, #7.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM placed thermometers in units.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: Observed presences of fruit flies and flies.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises. EHS advised CFM to request from pest control company specific treatment for fruit flies and flies.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back exit door. Observed gap to exterior of building between door threshold and bottom of back exit door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS advised CFM to install door sweep. CFM stated management aware of gap and waiting on repairs.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: #2 observed at 55F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS advised CFM not to store any TCS foods in unit. CFM advised to request repair of unit.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. EHS observed multi-quat sanitizer connected to 3 compartment sink dispenser. Signage on dispenser is for lactic acid sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a quaternary ammonia test kit. EHS provided test strip to CFM. EHS advised CFM to have staff verify identity of sanitizer being connected. CFM will use remainder of quaternary ammonia sanitizer and replace with lactic acid sanitizer.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed 4-way splitter installed on mop faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS provided approved backflow prevention device product information to CFM via email. EHS advised CFM to contact sanitizer company and install wasting tee, as an alternative option. EHS will follow up on or around 3 days to verify approved backflow prevention device has been ordered and/or installed.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections at the pre-rinse sink were observed leaking. Plumbing connections beneath the hand sink next to the back exit door were observed leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Contact licensed plumber to repair leaks.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed leak from ceiling next to dry storage racks. Observed leak from ceiling in dining area - specifically table underneath AC vent.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM stated leak may be from AC unit. CFM stated leak is from AC unit. CFM waiting on parts for repair.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed vents in ceiling throughout kitchen with accumulation of dust.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean vents.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed missing cover OR shielding for light bulbs in warewashing area.
violations.corrective_action: CFM will replace cover. GLORY DAYS GRILL (Inspection Date: 07/28/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: -Portioned rice (45F) and sliced tomato (44F) observed in walk in cooler. PIC stated temperatures may be high due to recent food delivery.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. -EHS instructed PIC to take temperatures and monitor food items to ensure they maintain at 41F or below.
